Khí hậu không có sự khác biệt lớn nhưng.en: There was no great difference in climate but due to the high mountain range of the Royal Lotus which blocked the wind, the climate was warmer than the Northeast. The population is mainly a lot of people like Thailand, Mongolia, Dao, Orgy, Nála...

Khí hậu nhiệt đới ẩm gió mùa, mùa hạ nón.en: Tropical climates of monsoons, hot summers and cold winters. This place is frequently subject to natural disasters, hurricanes. Khí hậu nhiệt đới ẩm gió mùa, mùa hạ nón.zh: 属季风热带气候,夏季炎热,冬季寒冷. 这个地方经常遭受自然灾害和飓风. 中央北方部有相当可观的出行资源,有众多废墟,著名的旅游区有克南南都,老都,冯,老鹰等,霍恩会馆之歌,斯瓦格浴场等. .

Khí hậu nhiệt đới ẩm gió mùa, mùa đông l.en: The tropical monsoon climate, cold winters that can diversify agricultural products. The river web is densely flowing with large rivers flowing through, providing irrigation water, traveling development, water traffic for the area.
